2026-09-28.meal: Baked cod with lemon & herb crumb, new potatoes & green beans

ingredients: Small handful fresh parsley, chopped (or 1 tsp dried)
steps: Heat the oven to 200°C (180°C fan). Boil the potatoes for 15 minutes.
Mix the breadcrumbs, lemon zest, parsley, melted butter and a pinch of salt.
Put the cod on a lined tray and press the crumb on top.
Bake for 12–15 minutes, until the crumb is golden and the fish flakes.
Cook the beans for the last 4 minutes of the potatoes. Serve with lemon wedges.
recipe.tip: Air fryer: 180°C for 10–12 minutes. Great with frozen cod: add 5 minutes and check it's piping hot in the middle.

2026-09-29.meal: Cheesy veggie quesadillas with side salad

ingredients: 400g tin black beans, drained and lightly mashed
steps: Mix the beans, pepper, sweetcorn, spring onions and paprika.
Spread the mix over 4 tortillas, top with cheese, and lay the other 4 tortillas on top.
Cook each one in a dry frying pan over a medium heat for 2–3 minutes a side, pressing down, until golden and the cheese melts.
Or air fry two at a time at 190°C for 6 minutes, turning halfway (a rack on top stops the lid flying).
Cut into wedges and serve with salad and salsa.
recipe.tip: Make them before the 6pm guitar lesson and keep them warm in a low oven. Leave paprika out of Mathilda's.

2026-09-30.meal: Sunday's ratatouille, reheated, with bread or rice

steps: Tip the ratatouille into a pan with a splash of water.
Heat gently, stirring, until it bubbles and is piping hot all the way through (about 8 minutes).
Or microwave in a covered bowl for 4–5 minutes, stirring halfway.
Serve with bread or rice, and a sprinkle of cheese if you like.
recipe.tip: Only reheat it once. Anyone eating after hockey can have their portion microwaved separately.

ingredients: 1 tbsp olive oil + knob of butter
50g parmesan or vegetarian hard cheese, grated
steps: Soften the leeks in the oil and butter for 5 minutes. Add the mushrooms and garlic and cook for 5 more.
Stir in the rice for 1 minute until coated.
Add the stock a ladle at a time, stirring, letting each one soak in before the next. It takes about 20 minutes.
When the rice is tender but still has a little bite, take it off the heat.
Stir in the cheese and crème fraîche, season, cover and rest for 2 minutes before serving.
recipe.tip: Oven shortcut: after step 2, add all the stock, cover and bake at 180°C for 25 minutes, then stir in the cheese.
